# Support

## Ask a question

Use the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=question.yml). Search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). If a change failed or did not undo, open the History page and quote the result in your report.

## Request a setting or a feature

- New Windows setting: the [setting request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=setting_request.yml). Add a link to an official Microsoft page.
- Other ideas: the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

## Fix a translation

Use the [translation fix form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Winora/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#persian-text).

## Security problems

Do not open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Good to know

- Issues are public. Never post your user name, computer name, product keys or network addresses.
- One volunteer answers in spare time. There is no email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported.
- The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies everywhere.

You can support the project at <https://enaloo.com/support/>.
